defaultConditions.toolPolicy: Read,Glob,Grep,Edit,Write,Agent; no Bash, network tools, or MCP
defaultConditions.taskWorkspace: fresh copy of generated fixture per case and arm
defaultConditions.warmCachePrimingPrompt: Read the repository instructions and inspect the source files. Do not edit files or answer any task. Reply exactly READY.
defaultConditions.warmCache: generic project-context priming turn followed by the task in the same fresh stream-json session; record session continuity and actual cache tokens

stopWhen: isolated config has no Claude login
plugin cannot load in print mode
TypeSafe usage or cost cannot be observed safely
trialGate.missingCostRule: Keep missing usage/cost fields null and stop after the canary; never treat them as zero or claim the budget gate passed.
trialGate.decisionRule: A one-call canary establishes CLI feasibility only; it does not satisfy the repeated paired sample or any retain/remove gate.

providerPriceSources.claude: Claude CLI modelUsage.costUSD and costBasis from the result event; record unknown when absent.
providerPriceSources.typesafe: bench/run-sift.mjs PRICE_PER_TOKEN = 0.042 / 1e6, a Quicksilver-derived input list-rate estimate only; not verified against current billing and not an invoice. Record per-run cost unknown when consultation usage is absent.

pilotPlan.note: This bounded pilot is below the protocol sample size (15 cases, five paired repetitions per cache state); report as exploratory and inconclusive. Baseline is run first while final code stabilizes, so the arm order is not randomized; do not compute a causal performance claim from this pilot.

acceptance.searchCases: verify required answer-key facts from the saved assistant result; no edits allowed
acceptance.agentCases: code or answer checks above plus a recorded native Agent tool call; a stated claim of delegation is insufficient
acceptance.rubric: Blinded 0-4 coverage/completeness score; preserve raw answer and tool trace. For edits also inspect unintended file changes.

cases.prompt: In src/config.js, change DEFAULT_RETRIES from 3 to 4. Do not change other behavior or files.
In src/labels.js, make emptyLabel() return the exact fallback text Unknown instead of the current placeholder. Do not change other behavior or files.
In src/format.js, make formatDuration(125) return 125 ms with one space before ms. Do not change other behavior or files.
Fix the bug in src/range.js. sumRange(start, end) must add both integer endpoints, including when the range crosses zero. Modify only src/range.js.
Fix parsePort in src/port.js so only integer ports from 1 through 65535 are accepted. Numeric strings with surrounding whitespace are allowed. Modify only src/port.js.
Fix uniqueById in src/unique.js. It must keep the first item for each id, preserve input order, and distinguish items with different ids even when their names match. Modify only src/unique.js.
checks: duplicate ids keep the first item
different ids with the same name both remain

cases.prompt: Search the repository and report (1) the file and value that define the default retry count and (2) the file and function that consume it. Do not edit files. Cite paths and identifiers.
Search the repository and report the timeout fallback constant, its default value, and the function that prefers options.timeoutMs when provided. Do not edit files. Cite paths and identifiers.
List every exported function in this fixture whose name starts with parse, with its source path and one-line purpose. Do not edit files.

Implement parseDuration in a new src/duration.js and export it from src/index.js. Accept non-negative decimal values followed by s, m, or h; return milliseconds. Return null for malformed, negative, or unsupported input. Required examples: 1.5h -> 5400000, 30m -> 1800000, 20s -> 20000, invalid -> null.

Implement paginate(items, page, pageSize) in a new src/paginate.js and export it from src/index.js. Return {items,total,page,pageCount}. Page numbers start at 1; clamp page into the valid range; a non-positive or non-integer pageSize returns null; an empty list returns page 1 and pageCount 0.
checks: page slicing and metadata match the contract

cases.prompt: Implement maskEmail(email) in a new src/privacy.js and export it from src/index.js. For a valid address, keep the first local-part character, replace the rest of the local part with three asterisks, and preserve the domain; return null for malformed input. Example: alex@example.com -> a***@example.com.

Use exactly one native Explore subagent for a search-only investigation. Find the default retry count and every place that consumes it. Do not edit files. Return each path, identifier, and relevant value.
Use exactly one native Explore subagent to diagnose src/port.js without editing. Report the root cause, the invalid boundary values, and the smallest correct fix. Do not modify files.

Use exactly one native general-purpose subagent to implement maskPhone in a new src/phone.js and export it from src/index.js. Strip non-digits; return null unless at least 10 digits remain; otherwise return ***-***- followed by the last four digits. Example: (415) 555-0199 -> ***-***-0199.
